{"code":"def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    base = inputs.get('g', inputs.get('base', inputs.get('a')))
    exponent = inputs.get('x', inputs.get('exponent', inputs.get('power', inputs.get('e'))))
    modulus = inputs.get('p', inputs.get('modulus', inputs.get('mod', inputs.get('m'))))
    if base is None or exponent is None or modulus is None:
        vals = [v for v in inputs.values() if isinstance(v, int)]
        base, exponent, modulus = vals[:3]
    return pow(int(base), int(exponent), int(modulus))"}
